properties.accuracy_caveat: REAL -- surveyed OpenStreetMap building footprint, not a hand trace or plan estimate; the west edge is idealized to a straight line (2 points instead of the OSM trace's 3, dropping a sub-meter digitizing jog), not a surveyed change. This is the opposite situation from Mission Bay's condo-mapped residential towers (Avalon, Radiance, etc.): here, ONE large Assessor land parcel spans SEVERAL UCSF buildings (confirmed against DataSF's Assessor parcel data and tax roll -- e.g. block/lot 8711507 (675 Mission Bay Blvd in DataSF's parcel data) alone is about 12.2 acres, far larger than any single building on it), so using the parcel boundary per building would make multiple records overlap and double-count the same ground. The real building footprint is the only non-overlapping, honest shape for this record.
properties.notes: ~150,000-156,600 sq ft (sources vary), four to five stories; houses a fitness center, conference center with an auditorium, gymnasium, swimming pools, food court and offices (Legorreta; Forell). The names 'Bakar Fitness & Recreation Center' and 'Mission Bay Conference Center' are not in any cited source. Architect Legorreta Arquitectos (Ricardo and Victor Legorreta) with MBT Architecture as associate/executive architect. Legorreta's project page lists the year 2005 (opening month not confirmed by a primary source). Per UCSF's own Dec 2024-updated campus map, this is Block 21B; the adjoining Community Center Garage to its west is the separate Block 21A (mapped as its own record).
